content.user_title: Address GitHub PR Comments with gh
content.value_statement: Pull request feedback can be scattered across comments and review threads. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured gh CLI cleanup.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether the GitHub CLI is authenticated before starting.
Guides review of comments on the current branch pull request.
Helps list review comments and propose a fix for each item.
Tells the assistant to ask for user confirmation when many comments exist.
Guides code changes for selected comments before posting a response.
Provides a basic PR comment response after fixes are applied.
limitations: Requires the GitHub CLI to be installed and authenticated.
Does not define repository-specific testing or validation steps.
Does not automatically resolve GitHub review threads.
Uses a generic response unless the user provides better wording.

use_cases.title: Handle PR Review Feedback
use_cases.description: Review comments on an open pull request, plan fixes, and respond after changes are complete.

use_cases.title: Triage Issue Feedback on a PR
use_cases.description: Inspect issue or pull request comments and decide which feedback needs code changes first.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Review Cleanup
use_cases.description: Create a clear sequence for addressing many review comments without losing context.

prompt_templates.title: Review Current PR Comments
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to inspect comments on my current branch pull request. Summarize each comment and ask before making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Fixes for Review Items
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to list open PR feedback, group related comments, and propose a fix plan before editing files.

prompt_templates.title: Address Selected Comments
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to address the comments I select. Make the code changes, explain the verification steps, and prepare a concise PR response.

prompt_templates.title: Manage a Large Review Thread
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to audit all PR comments, prioritize them by risk and dependency, batch related fixes, and draft final responses for each resolved thread.

output_examples.input: Inspect the current pull request comments and tell me what needs work.
output: Authentication was checked before reviewing the pull request.
Three comments need code changes and one comment only needs a clarification.
The next step is to confirm which comments should be fixed first.

output_examples.input: Address the reviewer comments about validation and update the PR.
output: The validation feedback was mapped to the affected files.
The selected fixes were applied and verification steps were listed.
A short PR response was prepared for the completed work.

output_examples.input: There are many comments. Help me prioritize them.
output: Blocking review comments were separated from cleanup suggestions.
Related comments were grouped into implementation batches.
The assistant asked for confirmation before starting the first batch.

best_practices: Review surrounding code before applying a fix for any comment.
Confirm the target comments before changing many files.
Run project tests or checks before posting that feedback is addressed.
anti_patterns: Do not post a resolved response before verifying the related change.
Do not address comments without understanding the reviewer context.
Do not assume GitHub CLI authentication or repository permissions are available.

faq.question: Does this skill require the GitHub CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow is built around gh commands and requires authenticated GitHub CLI access.

faq.question: Can it work with issue comments as well as PR comments?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes review comments and issue feedback, but the main workflow focuses on open pull requests.

faq.question: Does it automatically make code changes?
faq.answer: No. It guides the assistant to inspect comments, plan fixes, and ask for confirmation when needed.

faq.question: Does it close or resolve review threads?
faq.answer: No. It provides a basic PR comment response after fixes, but it does not define thread resolution commands.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks the skill as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I verify before posting a response?
faq.answer: Confirm the correct pull request, review the changed code, and run the repository checks that apply.
